subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Social Media Pyramids
description: Learn Social Media Pyramids in one minute.

hook.text: Instagram and TikTok have become the new recruiting grounds for pyramid schemes.

buildup.text: Influencers showcase luxury lifestyles funded by 'passive income' — which means recruiting followers.

discovery.text: Hashtags like #BossBabe and #FinancialFreedom often mask pyramid recruitment campaigns.

twist.text: Social media algorithms amplify these posts because high engagement means high ad revenue.

climax.text: Platforms profit from pyramid scheme content while their users lose money.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't filter scams — it promotes them.

quiz.question: Why do social media algorithms amplify pyramid scheme content?
options: High engagement means high ad revenue
